subtitle.en_us: Every key the preset moved, grouped by what you are doing.
subtitle.es_es: Cada tecla que movió el preset, agrupada por lo que estás haciendo.

en_us.title: A Keyboard for 300 Mods
en_us.subtitle: Somebody had to negotiate.
text: [lead] Three hundred mods, one keyboard: the busiest keys had five or six claimants each.
V, B, R, G, H, C, Z and the arrows were the hot ones. The preset moved the clashing actions to free keys or to [hl|Alt], [hl|Ctrl] and [hl|Shift] combinations.
It only fills keys you never set yourself: change one and your choice stays.

es_es.title: Un teclado para 300 mods
es_es.subtitle: Alguien tuvo que negociar.
text: [lead] Trescientos mods, un teclado: las teclas más disputadas tenían cinco o seis pretendientes.
V, B, R, G, H, C, Z y las flechas eran las calientes. El preset las mandó a teclas libres o a combinaciones con [hl|Alt], [hl|Ctrl] y [hl|Shift].
Sólo completa las que nunca configuraste: cambiá una y tu elección se queda.

en_us.title: Find Any Key
en_us.subtitle: Red keys are double-booked.
text: [lead] The key list now has a search box and a conflict filter.
[hl|Controlling] adds them to Options, Controls, Key Binds. A red key is used twice, which is fine when the two actions live in different places.
{page}
Unbound on purpose:
[li] Accessories' own screen (the Aether's stays on [key:key.aether.open_accessories.desc])
[li] Crafting on a Stick's second Curios key
[li] Ars Nouveau's next and previous spell slot: the [key:key.ars_nouveau.selection_hud] radial covers it
[li] Twilight's goggle zoom: Just Zoom covers it
[li] The Key Bundles radial, until you [quest:qol_controls_tip_bundles|bind it]

es_es.title: Encontrá cualquier tecla
es_es.subtitle: Una roja está usada dos veces.
text: [lead] La lista de teclas ahora tiene buscador y filtro de conflictos.
[hl|Controlling] los suma a Opciones, Controles, Asignación de teclas. Una tecla roja está usada dos veces, y está bien si las dos acciones viven en lugares distintos.
{page}
Sin tecla a propósito:
[li] La pantalla propia de Accessories (la del Aether sigue en [key:key.aether.open_accessories.desc])
[li] La segunda tecla de Curios de Crafting on a Stick
[li] La ranura de hechizo siguiente y anterior de Ars Nouveau: lo cubre el radial de [key:key.ars_nouveau.selection_hud]
[li] El zoom de antiparras de Twilight: lo cubre Just Zoom
[li] El radial de Key Bundles, hasta que lo [quest:qol_controls_tip_bundles|asignes]

en_us.title: Everyday Keys
text: [lead] Four keys for the daily routine; the rest have their own quests.
[li] [key:key.ftbquests.quests]: quest book
[li] [key:key.curios.open.desc]: Curios
[li] [key:key.sophisticatedbackpacks.open_backpack]: backpack
[li] [key:justzoom.keybinds.keybind.zoom]: zoom
{page}
The quest book used to sit on the grave-accent key. [item:entrelumen:terra_arm|Terra's Arm] and the vein resonator go in Curios; the backpack is the one you wear or carry, and zoom is Just Zoom.
The rest of the crowd:
[li] [key:key.ftbultimine], held: [quest:qol_controls_ultimine|Ultimine]
[li] [key:key.toolbelt.open]: [quest:qol_controls_toolbelt|the Tool Belt]
[li] [key:key.journeymap.map_toggle_alt], [key:key.journeymap.create_waypoint], [key:key.ftbchunks.claim_manager]: [quest:qol_controls_map|map, waypoints and claims]

es_es.title: Teclas de todos los días
text: [lead] Cuatro teclas para la rutina diaria; las demás tienen su propia quest.
[li] [key:key.ftbquests.quests]: libro de quests
[li] [key:key.curios.open.desc]: Curios
[li] [key:key.sophisticatedbackpacks.open_backpack]: mochila
[li] [key:justzoom.keybinds.keybind.zoom]: zoom
{page}

El libro de quests antes estaba en la tecla del acento grave. El [item:entrelumen:terra_arm|Brazo de Terra] y el resonador de vetas van en Curios; la mochila es la que llevás puesta o encima, y el zoom es el de Just Zoom.
El resto de la barra brava:
[li] [key:key.ftbultimine], mantenida: [quest:qol_controls_ultimine|Ultimine]
[li] [key:key.toolbelt.open]: [quest:qol_controls_toolbelt|el cinturón]
[li] [key:key.journeymap.map_toggle_alt], [key:key.journeymap.create_waypoint], [key:key.ftbchunks.claim_manager]: [quest:qol_controls_map|mapa, waypoints y reclamos]

en_us.title: Map and Waypoints
text: [lead] One key opens the map, another drops a waypoint under your feet.
[li] [key:key.journeymap.map_toggle_alt]: [hl|JourneyMap], full screen
[li] [key:key.journeymap.create_waypoint]: a waypoint where you stand
[li] [key:key.journeymap.fullscreen_create_waypoint]: inside the map, one at the cursor
{page}
[note] FTB Chunks' map key is unbound and its minimap off: it only handles teams and claims, with its claim manager on [key:key.ftbchunks.claim_manager].

es_es.title: Mapa y waypoints
text: [lead] Una tecla abre el mapa y otra clava un waypoint bajo tus pies.
[li] [key:key.journeymap.map_toggle_alt]: [hl|JourneyMap], pantalla completa
[li] [key:key.journeymap.create_waypoint]: un waypoint donde estás
[li] [key:key.journeymap.fullscreen_create_waypoint]: dentro del mapa, uno en el cursor
{page}
[note] La tecla del mapa de FTB Chunks está sin asignar y su minimapa apagado: sólo se ocupa de equipos y reclamos, con el administrador en [key:key.ftbchunks.claim_manager].

en_us.title: The Tool Belt Keys
en_us.subtitle: Your hotbar, on a strap.
text: [lead] Swap the tool in your hand without touching the hotbar.
Put a [item:toolbelt:belt|Tool Belt] in its slot, then:
[li] Hold [key:key.toolbelt.open]: a radial menu swaps your held item with one on the belt
[li] [key:key.toolbelt.slot]: opens the belt's slots
{page}
[note] [hl|R] is also the recipe key inside screens, but the belt only opens with none open, so they never clash. Aircraft dismount moved to [key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount] for the same reason.

es_es.title: Las teclas del cinturón
es_es.subtitle: Tu barra rápida, con correa.
text: [lead] Cambiá la herramienta de la mano sin tocar la barra rápida.
Poné un [item:toolbelt:belt|Tool Belt] en su ranura y:
[li] Mantené [key:key.toolbelt.open]: un menú radial cambia lo que tenés en la mano por algo del cinturón
[li] [key:key.toolbelt.slot]: abre las ranuras del cinturón
{page}

[note] [hl|R] también es la tecla de recetas dentro de las pantallas, pero el cinturón sólo se abre sin pantallas, así que nunca chocan. Bajarse de un avión pasó a [key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount] por lo mismo.

en_us.title: Ultimine: Break the Vein
en_us.subtitle: Hold, swing, done.
text: [lead] Hold one key and a single swing breaks the whole connected vein.
Hold [key:key.ftbultimine] while breaking a block. How far it reaches depends on the vein resonator you wear in a Curios charm slot.
[careful] Every extra block costs hunger, and with no resonator there is no Ultimine.
{page}
Reach by resonator tier:
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_1] Tier I: [hl|8] blocks
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_2] Tier II: [hl|16] blocks
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_3] Tier III: [hl|32] blocks
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_4] Tier IV: [hl|64] blocks
With the key held, [hl|Shift] and the mouse wheel (or the up and down arrows) switch shape: shapeless, tunnels or 3x3.
[note] Modern Industrialization's 3x3 tool toggle moved to [key:key.modern_industrialization.toggle_3x3].

es_es.title: Ultimine: rompé la veta
es_es.subtitle: Mantené, golpeá, listo.
text: [lead] Mantené una tecla y un solo golpe rompe toda la veta conectada.
Mantené [key:key.ftbultimine] al romper un bloque. El alcance depende del resonador de vetas que lleves en un slot de amuleto de Curios.
[careful] Cada bloque extra cuesta hambre, y sin resonador no hay Ultimine.
{page}
Alcance según el nivel del resonador:
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_1] Nivel I: [hl|8] bloques
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_2] Nivel II: [hl|16] bloques
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_3] Nivel III: [hl|32] bloques
[li:entrelumen:vein_resonator_4] Nivel IV: [hl|64] bloques
Con la tecla apretada, [hl|Shift] y la rueda del mouse (o las flechas arriba y abajo) cambian la forma: sin forma, túneles o 3x3.
[note] El modo 3x3 de las herramientas de Modern Industrialization pasó a [key:key.modern_industrialization.toggle_3x3].

en_us.title: Mekanism Armor Keys
text: [lead] Armor modes left V, G, J and B: they live on the arrow keys now.
[li] [key:key.mekanism.head_mode]: helmet
[li] [key:key.mekanism.chest_mode]: chestplate
[li] [key:key.mekanism.legs_mode]: leggings
[li] [key:key.mekanism.feet_mode]: boots
{page}
The [item:mekanism:mekasuit_helmet|MekaSuit] HUD toggles on [key:key.mekanism.key_hud] and the module tweaker on [key:key.mekanism.module_tweaker].

es_es.title: Teclas de armadura de Mekanism
text: [lead] Los modos de la armadura dejaron V, G, J y B: ahora viven en las flechas.
[li] [key:key.mekanism.head_mode]: casco
[li] [key:key.mekanism.chest_mode]: pechera
[li] [key:key.mekanism.legs_mode]: pantalones
[li] [key:key.mekanism.feet_mode]: botas
{page}
El HUD del [item:mekanism:mekasuit_helmet|MekaTraje] se prende con [key:key.mekanism.key_hud] y el ajustador de módulos con [key:key.mekanism.module_tweaker].

en_us.title: Flight and Travel Keys
text: [lead] Every way of flying got its own key. Crashing is still shared.
[li] [key:keybind.ironjetpacks.engine]: [item:ironjetpacks:jetpack|Iron Jetpacks] engine, [key:keybind.ironjetpacks.hover] hover
[li] [key:key.modern_industrialization.toggle_flight]: Modern Industrialization flight
[li] [key:key.ad_astra.toggle_suit_flight]: Ad Astra suit flight
{page}
[li] [key:key.ad_astra.open_radio]: Ad Astra radio
[li] [key:key.enderio.travel_staff]: [item:enderio:staff_of_travelling|Staff of Travelling]
[li] [key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount]: get off an Immersive Aircraft plane; [key:key.immersive_aircraft.boost] boosts it

es_es.title: Teclas de vuelo y viaje
text: [lead] Cada forma de volar tiene su tecla. Estrellarse sigue siendo compartido.
[li] [key:keybind.ironjetpacks.engine]: motor de [item:ironjetpacks:jetpack|Iron Jetpacks], [key:keybind.ironjetpacks.hover] flotar
[li] [key:key.modern_industrialization.toggle_flight]: vuelo de Modern Industrialization
[li] [key:key.ad_astra.toggle_suit_flight]: vuelo del traje de Ad Astra
{page}
[li] [key:key.ad_astra.open_radio]: radio de Ad Astra
[li] [key:key.enderio.travel_staff]: [item:enderio:staff_of_travelling|Bastón de viaje]
[li] [key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount]: bajarse de un avión de Immersive Aircraft; [key:key.immersive_aircraft.boost] lo impulsa

en_us.title: Magic Keys
text: [lead] Four magic systems, four sets of keys, zero fights.
[li] [key:key.ars_nouveau.selection_hud]: Ars Nouveau spell radial; [key:key.ars_nouveau.head_curio_hotkey], its crown potions
[li] [key:key.irons_spellbooks.spell_wheel]: Iron's Spells wheel; [key:key.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast], cast from the spellbook
{page}
[li] [key:psimisc.keybind]: Psi's main key; [hl|C] stays for the vanilla hotbar save and the Ars book
Mahou Tsukai:
[li] [key:key.drawMahoujin] magic circle, [key:key.changeMysticCode] mystic code
[li] [key:key.selectiveDisplacement] selective displacement, [key:key.settingsGUI] settings
[li] [key:key.gunUp] and [key:key.gunDown]: its guns

es_es.title: Teclas de magia
text: [lead] Cuatro sistemas de magia, cuatro juegos de teclas, cero peleas.
[li] [key:key.ars_nouveau.selection_hud]: radial de hechizos de Ars Nouveau; [key:key.ars_nouveau.head_curio_hotkey], sus pociones de corona
[li] [key:key.irons_spellbooks.spell_wheel]: rueda de Iron's Spells; [key:key.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast], lanzar desde el libro de hechizos
{page}
[li] [key:psimisc.keybind]: tecla principal de Psi; [hl|C] queda para guardar la barra rápida vanilla y para el grimorio de Ars
Mahou Tsukai:
[li] [key:key.drawMahoujin] círculo mágico, [key:key.changeMysticCode] código místico
[li] [key:key.selectiveDisplacement] desplazamiento selectivo, [key:key.settingsGUI] configuración
[li] [key:key.gunUp] y [key:key.gunDown]: sus armas

en_us.title: Exploration and Armor Abilities
text: [lead] The gear of every dimension brought hotkeys of its own.
[li] Aether: [key:key.aether.invisibility_toggle.desc] invisibility cloak

[li] Deep Aether: [key:key.deep_aether.toggle_skyjade_transparency] skyjade transparency, [key:key.deep_aether.stratus_dash_ability.desc] stratus dash, [key:key.deep_aether.slider_eye_ability] slider eye
{page}
[li] Twilight: [key:key.twilightforest.swap_hotbar] swaps the hotbar, [key:key.twilightforest.item_display_map_cycle] cycles item display maps
[li] Eternal Starlight: [key:key.eternal_starlight.switch_crest] switches crest
[li] Deeper and Darker: [key:key.deeperdarker.boost] boost, [key:key.deeperdarker.transmit] transmit
[li] Cataclysm armor: [key:key.cataclysm.ability], [key:key.cataclysm.helmet_ability] helmet, [key:key.cataclysm.chestplate_ability] chestplate, [key:key.cataclysm.boots_ability] boots

es_es.title: Exploración y habilidades
text: [lead] El equipo de cada dimensión trajo sus propias teclas.
[li] Aether: [key:key.aether.invisibility_toggle.desc] capa de invisibilidad

[li] Deep Aether: [key:key.deep_aether.toggle_skyjade_transparency] transparencia del skyjade, [key:key.deep_aether.stratus_dash_ability.desc] impulso de stratus, [key:key.deep_aether.slider_eye_ability] ojo del slider
{page}
[li] Twilight: [key:key.twilightforest.swap_hotbar] cambia la barra rápida, [key:key.twilightforest.item_display_map_cycle] cambia los mapas del exhibidor
[li] Eternal Starlight: [key:key.eternal_starlight.switch_crest] cambia de emblema
[li] Deeper and Darker: [key:key.deeperdarker.boost] impulso, [key:key.deeperdarker.transmit] transmitir
[li] Armadura de Cataclysm: [key:key.cataclysm.ability], [key:key.cataclysm.helmet_ability] casco, [key:key.cataclysm.chestplate_ability] pechera, [key:key.cataclysm.boots_ability] botas

en_us.title: Utility Keys
text: [lead] The odd jobs: villagers, magnets, satchels and gadgets.
[li] [key:key.easy_villagers.pick_up]: pick up a villager (Easy Villagers)
[li] [key:simplemagnets.keys.toggle]: [item:simplemagnets:basicmagnet|Simple Magnets]; [key:key.enderio.toggle_magnet], the Ender IO magnet
[li] [key:supplementaries.keybind.quiver]: Supplementaries quiver
{page}
[li] [key:key.occultism.ender_bag]: [item:occultism:ender_satchel|ender satchel]; [key:key.occultism.storage_remote], its storage remote; [key:key.occultism.backpack], its satchel
[li] [key:key.toastcontrol.clear]: clear notifications
[li] Building Gadgets: [key:key.buildinggadgets2.range] range, [key:key.buildinggadgets2.settings_menu] settings, [key:key.buildinggadgets2.anchor] anchor
{page}
[li] Just Dire Things: [key:justdirethings.key.toggle_tool], [key:justdirethings.key.toolUI]
[li] Draconic Evolution: [key:key.draconicevolution.place_item], [key:key.draconicevolution.tool_config]
[li] [key:key.hostilenetworks.open_deep_learner]: Hostile Neural Networks
[li] [key:key.oritech.augment_screen], held: Oritech implants

es_es.title: Teclas utilitarias
text: [lead] Los trabajos raros: aldeanos, imanes, morrales y aparatos.
[li] [key:key.easy_villagers.pick_up]: levantar un aldeano (Easy Villagers)
[li] [key:simplemagnets.keys.toggle]: [item:simplemagnets:basicmagnet|Simple Magnets]; [key:key.enderio.toggle_magnet], el imán de Ender IO
[li] [key:supplementaries.keybind.quiver]: carcaj de Supplementaries
{page}
[li] [key:key.occultism.ender_bag]: [item:occultism:ender_satchel|morral del ender]; [key:key.occultism.storage_remote], su control de almacén; [key:key.occultism.backpack], su morral
[li] [key:key.toastcontrol.clear]: borrar notificaciones
[li] Building Gadgets: [key:key.buildinggadgets2.range] alcance, [key:key.buildinggadgets2.settings_menu] configuración, [key:key.buildinggadgets2.anchor] fijar la vista
{page}
[li] Just Dire Things: [key:justdirethings.key.toggle_tool], [key:justdirethings.key.toolUI]
[li] Draconic Evolution: [key:key.draconicevolution.place_item], [key:key.draconicevolution.tool_config]
[li] [key:key.hostilenetworks.open_deep_learner]: Hostile Neural Networks
[li] [key:key.oritech.augment_screen], mantenida: implantes de Oritech

en_us.title: Apotheosis Keys
text: [lead] Two Apotheosis keys moved off Ctrl so they stop shadowing chat and Occultism's bag; the keys below show your current binding.
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.open_world_tier_select]: the World Tier screen (readable, but the story sets the tier)
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.toggle_radial_mining]: radial mining, on gear that has it
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.link_item_to_chat]: in an inventory, links the item to chat for your team to admire

es_es.title: Teclas de Apotheosis
text: [lead] Dos teclas de Apotheosis dejaron Ctrl para no tapar el chat ni la bolsa de Occultism; abajo ves tu combinación actual.
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.open_world_tier_select]: la pantalla de Niveles de Mundo (se lee, pero el nivel lo fija la historia)
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.toggle_radial_mining]: minería radial, en el equipo que la tenga
[li] [key:key.apotheosis.link_item_to_chat]: en un inventario, muestra el ítem en el chat para que tu equipo lo admire

en_us.title: LittleTiles Keys
text: [lead] LittleTiles, the small-block builder, has a set of its own.
[li] [key:key.little.mirror] mirror, [key:key.little.mark] mark
[li] [key:key.little.config.item] configure the held tool; [key:key.little.config_secondary.item], its secondary settings
[li] [key:key.little.building_mode] building mode; [key:key.little.undo] undo, [key:key.little.redo] redo
How to use them: [chapter:sector_building|Building].

es_es.title: Teclas de LittleTiles
text: [lead] LittleTiles, el constructor de bloques chiquitos, tiene su juego.
[li] [key:key.little.mirror] espejo, [key:key.little.mark] marcar
[li] [key:key.little.config.item] configurar la herramienta en mano; [key:key.little.config_secondary.item], sus opciones secundarias
[li] [key:key.little.building_mode] modo de construcción; [key:key.little.undo] deshacer, [key:key.little.redo] rehacer
Cómo usarlas: [chapter:sector_building|Construcción].

en_us.title: Keys Named by Position
text: [tip] The preset names several keys after US symbols, such as the semicolon, apostrophe, brackets and backslash, and Spanish or Latin American keyboards print something else on them.
Do not hunt for the symbol: the keys in these quests show your own label, and Controls shows it too. Or rebind it.

es_es.title: Teclas por posición
text: [tip] El preset nombra varias teclas con símbolos del teclado estadounidense, como el punto y coma, el apóstrofo, los corchetes y la barra invertida, y en un teclado español o latinoamericano esas teclas imprimen otra cosa.
No busques el símbolo: las teclas de estas quests muestran tu propia etiqueta, y Controles también. O reasignala.

en_us.title: Key Bundles
text: [tip] [hl|KeyBind Bundles] gathers rarely used actions into a radial menu behind one key.
It ships unbound: bind [hl|Open Bundle radial menu] in Controls and build bundles from its screen. Good candidates:
[li] Armor abilities
[li] Magic toggles
[li] Every Mahou Tsukai key

es_es.title: Paquetes de teclas
text: [tip] [hl|KeyBind Bundles] junta acciones que usás poco en un menú radial detrás de una sola tecla.
Viene sin asignar: asigná [hl|Open Bundle radial menu] en Controles y armá los paquetes desde su pantalla. Buenos candidatos:
[li] Habilidades de armadura
[li] Interruptores de magia
[li] Todas las teclas de Mahou Tsukai

en_us.title: Alt, Ctrl and Shift Win
text: [lead] When a combination and a plain key share a key, the modifier you hold wins.
[key:key.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast] casts a spell without dropping your item, and [key:key.apotheosis.toggle_radial_mining] toggles radial mining instead of selecting hotbar slot 9.
If a combination ever fires both actions, report it.

es_es.title: Alt, Ctrl y Shift ganan
text: [lead] Cuando una combinación y una tecla sola comparten tecla, gana el modificador que apretás.
[key:key.irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast] lanza un hechizo sin tirar el ítem, y [key:key.apotheosis.toggle_radial_mining] alterna la minería radial en vez de elegir la ranura 9 de la barra.
Si alguna combinación dispara las dos acciones, reportalo.

en_us.title: Pack Change: Client Defaults
text: [lead] A new profile also gets the pack's performance settings, auto-jump off and the pack's resource pack on.
They are only defaults: if your launcher already made an options file, existing values stay and only missing ones are added.
The settings themselves: [chapter:guide_qol_client|Performance, Sound and Screen].

es_es.title: Cambio del pack: valores base
text: [lead] Un perfil nuevo también recibe los ajustes de rendimiento del pack, el salto automático apagado y su paquete de recursos activado.
Son sólo valores iniciales: si tu launcher ya creó un archivo de opciones, lo que existe se queda y sólo se agrega lo que falta.
Los ajustes en sí: [chapter:guide_qol_client|Rendimiento, sonido y pantalla].

en_us.title: Your Keyboard, Your Rules
text: [lead] Everything here is a suggestion: keep what feels natural.
Rebind the rest with [hl|Controlling] and put the rare actions in a bundle.
When a new tool shows up, check back here: its key is probably already waiting.

es_es.title: Tu teclado, tus reglas
text: [lead] Todo esto es una sugerencia: quedate con lo que te resulte natural.
Reasigná el resto con [hl|Controlling] y guardá las acciones raras en un paquete.
Cuando aparezca una herramienta nueva, volvé acá: seguramente su tecla ya te está esperando.

en_us.title: Flip the Bench Lamp
text: [lead] One flick and the whole board lights up warm.
Every key you have learned already glows on its own. The lamp only adds mood.

es_es.title: Prender la lámpara del banco
text: [lead] Un toque y todo el teclado se baña de luz cálida.
Las teclas que aprendiste ya brillan solas. La lámpara sólo pone clima.

en_us.title: Press Caps Lock
text: [lead] One press and the little green light comes on.
The preset leaves this key alone. It is the only one nobody fights over.

es_es.title: Apretar Bloq Mayús
text: [lead] Un toque y se prende la lucecita verde.
El preset no toca esta tecla. Es la única que nadie se pelea.
